decisions.headline: 《控制：共振》独立 PC 分析称多数测试设备表现良好，Steam Deck 仍有压力
decisions.summary: IGN 的独立 PC 技术体验文章称，《Control Resonant》在作者测试的多数设备上性能良好，并讨论光照效果与较低配置设备的伸缩表现。作者同时指出 Steam Deck 在所选画面设置下仍吃力；这些结论仅对应作者测试，不作为所有硬件的性能保证。

entries.headline: Fox and Frog adventure hands-on explores its updated opening
entries.summary: 4Gamer’s TGS hands-on examines the updated Fox and Frog adventure. It opens in a lived-in apartment and follows a fox girl and her frog companion seeking a way home from a dark island. This is new hands-on analysis.

entries.headline: Control Resonant review weighs its open-world action and character story
entries.summary: IGN’s new review examines Control Resonant’s shift from the first game’s shooting and exploration toward open-world action and a more direct character story. The writer praises its bold conceptual continuity while finding some combat stretches frustrating or dull. These remain the reviewer’s opinions, with no aggregate score inferred.

entries.headline: BARKOUR hands-on discusses military-dog motion capture and agent movement
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s newly published hands-on examines stealth, parkour and canine movement in VARSAV Game Studios’ BARKOUR. The developers describe motion capture using a former Polish special-forces dog and incorporating pets’ curiosity and distraction. The Steam demo is available; this does not establish that it has just launched.

entries.headline: Yuru Camp game plans October 22 relaxation-app redesign and Steam version
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that enish announced on September 18 that the existing Yuru Camp game will end its old service on October 21 and become a Chill Time relaxation and work-support app the next day. Existing equipment, costumes and food carry over. A paid Steam Early Access version is planned for the same day.

entries.headline: Control Resonant PC analysis praises tested systems but notes Steam Deck strain
entries.summary: IGN’s independent PC analysis praises Control Resonant’s performance on most systems the writer tested and examines lighting and scaling to lower-end hardware. The writer also notes Steam Deck struggles at the chosen settings. These findings concern the author’s tests and are not guarantees for all hardware.
